questions.question: Line r is defined by the equation 4x − 5y = 8. Line s is parallel to line r in the xy-plane. What is the slope of line s?
questions.explanation: y = (4/5)x − 8/5, so line r has slope 4/5, and a parallel line has the same slope.

questions.question: The function h is defined by h(x) = 5|x|. What is the value of h(−3)?

The function f(x) = −40x + 340 gives the predicted height above the ground f(x), in feet, of a model airplane x minutes after it begins to descend. What is the predicted height above the ground, in feet, of the model airplane 3 minutes after it begins to descend?
The function f is defined by f(x) = (1)/(8x). What is the value of f(x) when x = 9?
Line s is defined by x − 4y = 24. Line t is perpendicular to line s in the xy−plane and passes through the points (k, 0) and (60, −k). What is the value of k?
questions.explanation: Line s has slope 1/4, so line t has slope −4. Then −k/(60 − k) = −4, so k = 240 − 4k and k = 48.

questions.question: In the xy-plane, line ℓ passes through the point (0, 0) and is parallel to the line represented by the equation y = 6x + 3. If line ℓ also passes through the point (3, d), what is the value of d?

A line segment that has a length of 113 centimeters (cm) is divided into three parts. One part is 47 cm long. The other two parts have lengths that are equal to each other. What is the length, in cm, of one of the other two parts of equal length?
questions.explanation: The other two parts total 113 − 47 = 66 cm, so each is 66 ÷ 2 = 33 cm.

questions.question: Which expression is equivalent to √x153, where x > 0?
questions.explanation: A square root is the 1/2 power: (x<sup>153</sup>)<sup>1/2</sup> = x<sup>153/2</sup>.

questions.question:
x2 − 2x = 29
What is one of the solutions to the given equation?
questions.explanation: Complete the square: (x − 1)^2 = 30, so x = 1 ± √(30).

questions.question: In the xy−plane, the graph of the equation y = −x2 + 9x − 72 intersects the line y = c at exactly one point. What is the value of c?
questions.explanation: The line touches the parabola only at its vertex. At x = 9/2, y = −81/4 + 81/2 − 72 = −207/4.

questions.question: The function f is defined by f(x) = −10(3)^x + (1)/(k), where k is a constant. If y = f(x) is graphed in the xy−plane, what is the y−coordinate of the y−intercept of the graph?

f(x) = 18x2 − 45x + 13
The given equation defines the function f. For what value of x does f(x) reach its minimum?
questions.explanation: The vertex is at x = 45/(2·18) = 1.25.

questions.question: The function f is defined by f(x) = ax<sup>2</sup> + bx + c, where a, b, and c are constants. The graph of y = f(x) in the xy-plane passes through the points (10, 0) and (−5, 0). If a is an integer greater than 1, which of the following could be the value of a + b?
An object moves at a speed of 352 feet per second. What is this speed, in yards per second? (3 feet = 1 yard)
A certain pigeon species can fly at an average speed of 16 meters per second when in continuous flight. At this rate, how many meters would this pigeon species fly in 4 seconds?

On January 1, 2000, the population of a town was 26,252 and on January 1, 2010, the population was 26,753. The equation 10x + 26,252 = 26,753 describes this situation. Which of the following is the best interpretation of x in this context?
options: The percentage by which the population of the town increased each year between 2000 and 2010
The total increase in population between 2000 and 2010
The projected population of the town 10 years after 2010
The average increase per year of the population between 2000 and 2010
questions.explanation: The population grew by 26,753 − 26,252 = 501 over 10 years, so 10x is the total increase and x is the average increase per year.

questions.question: A certain elephant calf weighed 226 pounds when it was born. The elephant calf gained an average of 3 pounds per day in its first year of life. Which equation models this situation, where y is the estimated weight of the elephant calf, in pounds, x days after it was born?
questions.explanation: The starting weight is 226 pounds and 3 pounds are added each day, so y = 226 + 3x.

questions.question: A survey of 500 adults finds a correlation coefficient of 0.7 between the number of hours spent reading per week and their vocabulary test scores. The survey also reports that 60% of participants read more than 5 hours per week, with a margin of error of ±5%. Which conclusion is most appropriate?
options: Reading more hours per week causes higher vocabulary scores.
There is a strong positive relationship between reading hours and vocabulary scores, but causation cannot be determined.
Between 55% and 65% of adults read more than 5 hours per week, and this improves their vocabulary.
The correlation of 0.7 means 70% of vocabulary scores are explained by reading hours.
questions.topic: Evaluating statistical claims: Observational studies and experiments

questions.question: Circle A has a radius of 3x and circle B has a radius of 135x. The area of circle B is how many times the area of circle A?
questions.explanation: Radius ratio is 135/3 = 45, so the area ratio is 45² = 2025.

questions.question: In triangle PQR, QR is extended to point S. The measure of ∠PQR is 114°, and the measure of ∠PRS is 158°. What is the measure of ∠QPR?
questions.explanation: The exterior angle equals the sum of the two remote interior angles: 158° = 114° + ∠QPR, so ∠QPR = 44°.

questions.question: In December 2017, the lowest temperature recorded in a certain city was 40 degrees Fahrenheit (°F) and the highest temperature recorded was 90 °F. Which inequality is true for all values of t, where t represents any temperature, in °F, recorded in the city in December 2017?
questions.explanation: Every recorded temperature lies between the lowest (40) and highest (90), inclusive.

questions.question:
34x + 79y = 260
The given equation represents the volume of mulch x, in cubic feet, and the volume of soil y, in cubic feet, in a mixture of mulch and soil that weighs 260 pounds. If the volume of soil in the mixture is 2 cubic feet, what is the volume of mulch in the mixture, in cubic feet?
questions.explanation: Substitute y = 2: 34x + 158 = 260, so 34x = 102 and x = 3.

questions.question: In the xy−plane, the graph of the linear function h contains the points (0, 0) and (1, 10). Which equation defines h, where y = h(x)?
questions.explanation: The slope is (10 − 0)/(1 − 0) = 10 and the y-intercept is 0, so h(x) = 10x.

questions.question: In the xy−plane, which of the following does NOT contain any points that are part of the solution set to 5x − 7y > 35?
questions.explanation: If x < 0 and y > 0, then 5x is negative and −7y is negative, so 5x − 7y is negative and can never exceed 35. The other regions all contain solutions (for example (8, 0), (10, 1), (−1, −10)).

questions.question: f(x) = 3(x − 1)(x − 8)(x − 11). If the given function f is graphed in the xy-plane, where y = f(x), what is the x-coordinate of an x-intercept of the graph?
questions.explanation: An x-intercept occurs where f(x) = 0, so x = 1, 8, or 11.

questions.question:
v = −w161x
The given equation relates the distinct positive numbers v, w, and x. Which equation correctly expresses w in terms of v and x?
questions.explanation: Multiply both sides by −161x: w = −161vx.

questions.question: A linear model estimates the population of a city from 1993 to 2017. The model estimates the population was 52 thousand in 1993, 219 thousand in 2013, and x thousand in 2017. To the nearest whole number, what is the value of x?
questions.explanation: The rate is (219 − 52)/20 = 8.35 thousand per year, so x = 219 + 4 × 8.35 = 252.4 ≈ 252.

questions.question:
−x − wy = −337
2x − wy = 47
In the given system of equations, w is a constant. In the xy-plane, the graphs of these equations intersect at the point (q, 19), where q is a constant. What is the value of w?
questions.explanation: Subtracting the equations gives 3x = 384, so x = 128. Then −128 − 19w = −337, so w = 11.

questions.question: The equation h = 9(v − 273.15)5 + 32 gives the corresponding temperature h, in degrees Fahrenheit, of any substance that has a temperature of v kelvins, where v > 0. If a substance has a temperature of 539.33 degrees Fahrenheit, what is the corresponding temperature, in kelvins, of this substance?
Which expression is equivalent to 158t<sup>3</sup> − 24t<sup>2u</sup>?
questions.explanation: Factor out 2t^2.

questions.question: For the exponential function f, the value of f(1) is k, where k is a constant. Which of the following equivalent forms of the function f shows the value of k as the coefficient or the base?
questions.explanation: In choice C, f(1) = 144.5(1.7)^0 = 144.5, and 144.5 appears as the coefficient.

questions.question:
f(x) = −16x2 + 71
The function f gives the estimated height, in feet, of an acorn x seconds after the acorn fell from a tree. Based on the function, what is the estimated height, in feet, of the acorn before it fell from the tree?
questions.explanation: Before the acorn fell, x = 0, so f(0) = 71 feet.

questions.question: For the polynomial function v, v(2) = 3 and v(0) = −13. The graph of y = v(x) in the xy-plane passes through the points (−2, 7) and (6, 0). Which of the following must be true?
options: When v(x) is divided by (x + 13), the remainder is 0.
When v(x) is divided by (x + 7), the remainder is −2.
When v(x) is divided by (x + 2), the remainder is 7.
When v(x) is divided by (x − 6), the remainder is −13.

questions.question: A quadratic function models the height, in feet, of an object above the ground in terms of the time, in seconds, after the object was launched. The model estimates that the object was launched from an initial height of 0.00 feet above the ground and was at a maximum height of 207.36 feet above the ground 3.6 seconds after it was launched. The model also estimates that the object was at a height of 184.32 feet above the ground x seconds after it was launched. What is a possible value of x?
questions.explanation: The vertex is (3.6, 207.36) and the curve passes through (0, 0), so y = 207.36 − 16(x − 3.6)^2. Setting y = 184.32 gives 16(x − 3.6)^2 = 23.04, so x − 3.6 = ±1.2 and x = 2.4 or 4.8.

questions.question: A sleep study consisted of 59 participants, of which 53 participants each had an average of more than 120 minutes of rapid eye movement (REM) sleep per night. If a participant from this sleep study is selected at random, what is the probability of selecting a participant that had an average of more than 120 minutes of REM sleep per night?
questions.explanation: The probability is 53 out of 59 participants.

questions.question: The area of a rectangular region is increasing at a rate of 110 square feet per hour. Which of the following is closest to this rate in <u>square meters per minute</u>? (Use 1 meter = 3.28 feet.)
questions.explanation: 110 ft^2/hr ÷ (3.28)^2 ≈ 10.22 m^2/hr, and dividing by 60 minutes gives ≈ 0.17 m^2/min.
